names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 10006, «Николай (Панков), мч.», with the rank word after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname, so the surname is read off the name link, where the calendar prints it, and it is part of the name and stays. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'николаи панков' has no other holder in the corpus, where the bare «Николай» has very many.

death.note: The year the day line prints for the three of them: «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера и чад его мчч. Николая и Петра (1918).» No year of birth appears on the name page, which is all the calendar gives him, and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера и чад его мчч. Николая и Петра (1918).»

attestations.note: The second person of the day’s fifth entry, ONE LINE NAMING THREE: the other two are `john-pankov`, the priest the line calls his father, and `peter-pankov`, separate folders of this batch. THE RELATION IS THE LINE’S OWN WORD, «чад его», his children. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: page 10006 prints the title «Николай (Панков), мч.» and «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 26 апреля» and nothing else. What it gives that the line does not is the surname «Панков». He is graded «мч.», martyr, with NO CLERICAL RANK ANYWHERE, so no `office` was written and `presbyter` was not reached for; 26 января is the general commemoration of the new martyrs and confessors, which is how `new-martyr` is read into `types`, and THAT DAY PAGE WAS NOT READ. NOTHING ON EITHER PAGE SAYS HOW OLD HE WAS or whether the two sons were grown men, so nothing of the kind is in this folder. NO FOLDER WAS FOUND FOR HIM: `grep -rl 'Панков'` over `saints/` returns nothing and the gate’s own key function returns no holder for 'николаи панков' or 'nicholas pankov'. The day page prints five hymns and none under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
